cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll organise this load. I agreed to carry one box to the van.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You promised to help me move.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With one box. You choose it and I'll take it out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Lift it into my arms. I agreed to carry it; you can handle getting it off the floor.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 runs loading under one-box promise; A3 gives B selection power; A5 accepts largest but narrows carry to require B lifting cooperation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 broad move claim causes A3 exact one-box callback; B4 biggest choice causes A5 lifting-versus-carrying distinction.

relationship.evidence: B4 uses the literal limit to get the largest useful contribution, an active countermove.

heightening.evidence: A5 preserves the agreement while narrowing which part of the bigger task belongs to A, directly caused by B4.

specificity.evidence: A1 van and box, B4 largest and A5 from floor into arms establish the physical proposal without unseen action.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 wording distinction tells B exactly what help A requires rather than celebrating the word itself.
